comments.author: @JohnThomas-ln3wz
comments.text: I could never visit Cuba again while this administration exists! 2025 was my last visit there, and the conditions that country is in is horrifying! I use to love that country, so sad.

replies.author: @JohnThomas-ln3wz
replies.text: ​@reallifeincountriesThe people were much happier. Being able to get my Behike cigars I couldn't get in the states, and it didn't seem that people weren't surviving just to eat! I like Varadero Resort much better than Havana, because the beaches were more beautiful, and the town was much cleaner. Love the hospitality.
